scenarios.answer: Our return policy allows you to return products that are undamaged and complete. You can try the product, but items with signs of use are not accepted. You only need the order number for the return; an invoice is not required. Returns must be requested within 30 days from the delivery date. After 30 days, return requests are not accepted, and the product will be evaluated under warranty. If you use our contracted carrier Anadolu Kargo for the return, the shipping is free by showing the return code at the branch. If you send the product with your own courier, the shipping cost will not be refunded. Once the product arrives at the warehouse and passes inspection, the refund will be processed within 5 business days to the original payment method. For cash on delivery orders, the refund will be made to the account holder's IBAN number. Some products cannot be returned, such as opened in-ear headphones, personal care products, opened software packages, and custom-made products [İade Politikası:Genel Koşullar] [İade Politikası:İade Süresi] [İade Politikası:İade Kargo Ücreti] [İade Politikası:Geri Ödeme Süresi] [İade Politikası:İade Edilemeyen Ürünler].
